query: SELECT e.name,c.location,l.label,a.value AS trust FROM entities e LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.entity_id=e.id LEFT JOIN relationships l ON l.from_id=e.id LEFT JOIN entity_attributes a ON a.entity_id=l.entity_id AND a.attribute_id='1882882f-8f52-4cbf-a9f3-cf080d35b498' WHERE e.story_id='7b6992ba-996a-4b13-9750-bef67d3eb4c0'
